rationale: The filing's final Total Investments row is the grand total and includes both debt and equity investments at fair value of $224,956,333 and cash equivalents at fair value of $5,325,046. These sum exactly to $230,281,379. The companyfacts value of $224,956,000 is the rounded Level 3/debt-and-equity subtotal and excludes the separately presented cash equivalents. The grand total is 99.26% of total assets of $232,002,000, leaving a plausible $1,720,621 of other net assets.
